title: Farming in the Nile Valley
summary: A Neolithic crop-based economy appears in the Nile Valley around 7,000 years ago, probably brought by migrants from the Fertile Crescent.
why: The food base for later Egyptian civilisation.

notes.problem: 'Permanent farming by about 6,500 years ago' is not in source; source gives crop economy 'around 7,000 BP' and ties Nile farming to migration from the Fertile Crescent.
